== Notes ==
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable [[corpse]]. 
* At level 20 (rank 5) it has 15 in [[Fire Magic]].
* This creature attacks at less than normal range for wands and spells.
{{anomaly|The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon ''per player''.}}
{{anomaly|Unlike regular [[Ruby Djinn]], the creature summoned by this skill is [[fleshy]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The summoned creature is a result of Asuran technology designed to imitate the creature they resemble.
* The [[skill icon]] is a manipulation of [[:File:"Delta Djinn" concept art 2.jpg|djinn concept art]].
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
